local_findings.title: Settings Apply Retention sat past the minimum window's content width
local_findings.repair: the retention row ends inside 700 pt.

local_findings.repair: History actions laid out again at every size in two rows.

local_findings.title: History's manifest branch served an artifact of the wrong role as the job's final text
local_findings.repair: HistoryQueryService._job_artifacts uses a manifest id only for the role it names; corrupt data leaves the stage absent.

local_findings.title: The artifact purge unlinked, and payload reads opened, corrupt locators outside the managed root
local_findings.repair: Artifact unlinks, payload reads and the deep integrity check go through the confined no-follow helpers.

local_findings.title: A lost jobs or artifacts table was recreated empty while never-deleted referrers survived
local_findings.repair: _CORE_DEPENDENTS refuses the repair when usage, insertion or target rows, or a job naming its audio artifact, survive.

local_findings.title: History Copy and Paste Again could publish a final purged after its detail rendered
local_findings.repair: Both re-check the final's artifact before publishing.

local_findings.title: Replay reported no_audio_artifact for purged audio
local_findings.repair: Replay shows the detail's own unavailable reason.

local_findings.title: A retry committing attempt 2 while History read attempt 1 left the Hub on attempt 1
local_findings.repair: The commit reloads History (HubState.job_changed), superseding the older read.

local_findings.title: Push-to-talk minted the capture instant three times, so the usage fact trailed History's capture time by the mic-open latency and a retry moved it
local_findings.repair: startDictation mints one instant for the job row, the capture journal and the in-memory job.

independent_review.method: Each round a fresh-context agent reviewed the delta in a detached read-only worktree, given the audits, decisions, records and code, not the author's dispositions. Every allegation was reproduced by the author with an independently written fail-first witness before any change; mutants were added for each repair.
independent_review.convergence_bar: From round 7: a round converges when it finds no correctness, data-loss or privacy defect reachable in single-user use; lesser items are recorded as residuals.
